'''Bald-Wampa ISB Ops deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Bald-Wampa]]
* '''Published:''' 11 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif|label=ISB Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' ISB Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor ISB Bald-Wampa DS 2003 ISBOpsde.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is the only deck that I can play, and that I can play fairly well. I think its pretty good deck but I still need to get some kinks out of it. Any input would help.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

The strategy: The first couple rounds I get out Hoth DB and Yavin 4 DB. Then I put down a few ISB agents and flip the objective. Then I start adding to my drains and subtracting theres.
